WITH amts AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL) AS loss_payment_amount,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL) AS loss_reserve_amount,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL) AS expense_payment_amount,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL) AS expense_reserve_amount
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_payment) lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve) lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM acme_insurance.main.expense_payment) ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve) er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage cc
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
  FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount pa
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM acme_insurance.main.premium) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
roles AS (
  SELECT apr.Agreement_Identifier,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ') FILTER (WHERE rl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'PH') AS policy_holder_party_id,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(TRIM(per.First_Name || ' ' || per.Last_Name), org.Organization_Name), ', ') FILTER (WHERE rl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'PH') AS policy_holder,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ') FILTER (WHERE rl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agent%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'AG') AS agent_party_id,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(TRIM(per.First_Name || ' ' || per.Last_Name), org.Organization_Name), ', ') FILTER (WHERE rl.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agent%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'AG') AS agent
  FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role rl ON rl.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person per ON per.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.organizations org ON org.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier

)
